figures.code_text:
# House mosaic, ABA kinetics: single-column 2x4 page (89 x 183 mm) of a simulated grapevine drought
# trial: time course (line), expression vs stem water potential (small multiples), VvNCED3 by
# tissue (raincloud) and log2 FC of DEGs (density). Reads data*.csv only. Run from this directory.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(ggplot2); library(patchwork) })
source("../../../styles/r/theme_house.R")
grDevices::cairo_pdf(tempfile(fileext = ".pdf"))   # Arial metrics while tiles are measured; closed at the end
pal <- pv_palette("house"); grey <- pv_palette("house_grey"); warm <- pv_palette("house_warm")
TAG_PT <- 10; T7 <- pv_pt2size(7)
minus <- function(x) gsub("-", "\u2212", if (is.character(x)) x else format(x, trim = TRUE))   # no padding of strings
pt_layer <- function(...) geom_point(shape = HOUSE_POINT$shape, size = HOUSE_POINT$size,
                                     stroke = HOUSE_POINT$stroke, colour = "black", ...)
th <- theme_house()
tc <- c(WW = grey[["mid"]], SD = pal[["red"]])                         # treatment colours (whole series)
tis <- c("Leaf", "Root", "Shoot tip", "Berry skin", "Seed")
tis_c <- stats::setNames(unname(pal[c("green", "brown", "gold", "purple", "sky")]), tis)   # one colour per tissue
rd <- function(f) utils::read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

# --- tile helpers: every panel is a standalone ggplot placed on whole grid cells by
# pv_house_mosaic(). tile() pins the outer bands so panel frames line up across tiles.
# Fixed outer bands (mm) so panel frames line up across tiles in the same column/row:
# left = y ticks + title, bottom = x ticks + title, top = room for the tag.
BAND <- list(l = 11.5, b = 8.6, t = 4.2, r = 1.2)
.mm <- function(u) as.numeric(grid::convertUnit(u, "mm", valueOnly = TRUE))
.width_mm  <- function(g, idx) if (length(idx)) sum(vapply(idx, function(i) .mm(grid::convertWidth(g$widths[i], "mm")), 0)) else 0
.height_mm <- function(g, idx) if (length(idx)) sum(vapply(idx, function(i) .mm(grid::convertHeight(g$heights[i], "mm")), 0)) else 0

# tile(): ggplot -> grob with fixed bands and a bold tag at the tile's top-left corner.
tile <- function(p, tag = NULL, l = BAND$l, b = BAND$b, t = BAND$t, r = BAND$r) {
  p <- .pv_set_text_family(p + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)))
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)
  pan <- g$layout[grepl("^panel", g$layout$name), ]
  pl <- min(pan$l); pr <- max(pan$r); pt <- min(pan$t); pb <- max(pan$b)
  nc <- length(g$widths); nr <- length(g$heights)
  fit <- function(have, want, side) {
    if (have > want + 0.01) stop(sprintf("tile %s: %s band needs %.2f mm > %.2f", tag, side, have, want))
    grid::unit(want - have, "mm")
  }
  g$widths[1]   <- g$widths[1]  + fit(.width_mm(g, seq_len(pl - 1)), l, "left")
  g$widths[nc]  <- g$widths[nc] + fit(.width_mm(g, if (pr < nc) (pr + 1):nc else integer()), r, "right")
  g$heights[1]  <- g$heights[1] + fit(.height_mm(g, seq_len(pt - 1)), t, "top")
  g$heights[nr] <- g$heights[nr] + fit(.height_mm(g, if (pb < nr) (pb + 1):nr else integer()), b, "bottom")
  if (!is.null(tag)) g <- add_tag(g, tag)
  g
}
add_tag <- function(g, tag) {
  grid::grobTree(g, grid::textGrob(tag, x = grid::unit(0.3, "mm"), y = grid::unit(1, "npc") - grid::unit(0.2, "mm"),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = house_family(), fontface = "bold", fontsize = TAG_PT)))
}
# footnote(): small grey 7 pt note inside a tile's band (simulated data disclaimer)
SIM_NOTE <- "Simulated data for illustration; not biological results"
footnote <- function(g, label = SIM_NOTE, x = 1, y = 1, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, dx = -1.2, dy = -0.6) {
  grid::grobTree(g, grid::textGrob(label, x = grid::unit(x, "npc") + grid::unit(dx, "mm"), y = grid::unit(y, "npc") + grid::unit(dy, "mm"),
    hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust, gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = house_family(), fontsize = 7, col = grey[["mid"]], lineheight = 0.95)))
}
# top_anchor(): cairo_pdf truncates the page to whole points (e.g. 183 mm = 518.74 pt -> 518 pt) and the
# mosaic is placed from the bottom, so the top lost up to 0.26 mm. On PDF devices, shift the page down by
# that fraction so blocks are laid out from the top edge; PNG devices are exact and need no shift.
top_anchor <- function(m, h_mm) structure(grid::gTree(children = grid::gList(m), h_mm = h_mm, cl = c("pv_top", class(m))),
                                          pv_cells = attr(m, "pv_cells"))
makeContext.pv_top <- function(x) {
  h_pt <- x$h_mm / 25.4 * 72
  dy <- if (grepl("pdf", names(grDevices::dev.cur()), ignore.case = TRUE)) h_pt - floor(h_pt) else 0
  x$vp <- grid::viewport(y = grid::unit(1, "npc") - grid::unit(dy, "bigpts"), height = grid::unit(1, "npc"), just = "top")
  x
}
# patchwork / composite tiles: tag only (they control their own inner layout)
tile_pw <- function(p, tag) add_tag(patchwork::patchworkGrob(p), tag)

# --- parameters ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
page_cells <- c(2, 4)
gwas_top <- "VvNCED3"   # top hit of the companion GWAS figure (house-mosaic-gwas); the b title claims it

kin <- rd("data.csv"); sm <- rd("data_psi.csv"); vi <- rd("data_raincloud.csv"); fc <- rd("data_fc.csv")

# a time course ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
genes <- c(VvNCED3 = pal[["red"]], VvRD29B = pal[["orange"]], "VvPIP2;1" = pal[["blue"]])
b2a <- ggplot(kin, aes(hours, log2fc, colour = gene, fill = gene)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "22", linewidth = pv_house_lw("ref"), colour = grey[["ref"]]) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = log2fc - se, ymax = log2fc + se), colour = NA, alpha = 0.22) + geom_line(linewidth = pv_house_lw("main")) + pt_layer() +
  geom_text(data = kin[kin$hours == max(kin$hours), ], aes(x = max(kin$hours) + 7, label = gene), hjust = 0, size = T7, fontface = "bold.italic") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = genes, guide = "none") + scale_fill_manual(values = genes, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-5, 214), breaks = c(0, 48, 96, 144), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3, 6), breaks = c(-2, 0, 2, 4), labels = minus, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Hours after withholding water", y = "log2 FC (SD/WW, leaf)") + th

# b small multiples: expression vs stem water potential -----------------------------------------
sm$gene <- factor(sm$gene, levels = c("VvNCED3", "VvRD29B", "VvPIP2;1", "VvLEA4"))
rlab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(sm, sm$gene), function(s) data.frame(gene = s$gene[1], r = stats::cor(s$psi, s$expression))))
n_vine <- as.integer(table(sm$gene)[as.character(rlab$gene)])
rlab$lab <- sprintf("'Pearson '*italic(r)*' = %s, '*italic(n)*' = %d'", minus(sprintf("%.2f", rlab$r)), n_vine)
r_top <- as.character(rlab$gene[which.max(abs(rlab$r))])        # gene with the tightest link
rlab$col <- ifelse(rlab$gene == r_top, pal[["red"]], "#000000")
sm$hl <- ifelse(sm$gene == r_top, pal[["red"]], pal[["sky"]])
# consistency: b's claim, and the sign of r vs the direction in a (up in drought <-> negative r)
stopifnot(r_top == gwas_top, length(unique(n_vine)) == 1,
          diff(sort(round(abs(rlab$r), 2), decreasing = TRUE)[1:2]) <= -0.02,   # "tightest" is visible at the printed 2 dp
          sign(rlab$r[rlab$gene == "VvNCED3"]) == -sign(kin$log2fc[kin$gene == "VvNCED3" & kin$hours == 48]),
          sign(rlab$r[rlab$gene == "VvPIP2;1"]) == -sign(kin$log2fc[kin$gene == "VvPIP2;1" & kin$hours == 48]))
b2b <- ggplot(sm, aes(psi, expression)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(colour = I(ifelse(gene == r_top, pal[["red"]], "black"))), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, fill = grey[["ci"]], linewidth = pv_house_lw("main")) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = I(hl)), shape = 21, size = 1.5, stroke = HOUSE_POINT$stroke, colour = "black") + facet_wrap(~gene, nrow = 2) +
  geom_text(data = rlab, aes(x = -0.35, y = 10.6, label = lab, colour = I(col)), hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = T7, parse = TRUE) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.8, -0.2), breaks = c(-1.5, -1, -0.5), labels = minus, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1, 11), breaks = c(3, 6, 9), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "\u03a8stem (MPa)", y = "Expression (log2 CPM)",
       title = bquote("Strongest correlation with \u03a8stem: "*italic(.(r_top))*" ("*italic(r)*" = "*.(minus(sprintf("%.2f", rlab$r[rlab$gene == r_top])))*");"),
       subtitle = "its locus also carries the top GWAS signal (Fig. 3a)") + th +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(2.5, "mm"), strip.text = element_text(face = "italic"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 7, colour = pal[["red"]], hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 0.4, unit = "mm")),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, colour = pal[["red"]], hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 1.2, unit = "mm")))

# c horizontal raincloud: VvNCED3 by tissue x treatment ---------------------------------------
vi$y0 <- ifelse(vi$tissue == "Leaf", 3.15, 1.05) + ifelse(vi$treatment == "WW", 0.45, -0.45)
dens <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(vi, list(vi$tissue, vi$treatment)), function(s) {
  d <- stats::density(s$expression, adjust = 1.1, n = 128)
  data.frame(x = d$x, h = d$y / max(d$y) * 0.55, y0 = s$y0[1], treatment = s$treatment[1]) }))
dens <- dens[dens$x >= 2 & dens$x <= 10, ]
qs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(vi, list(vi$tissue, vi$treatment)), function(s) data.frame(y0 = s$y0[1],
  q1 = stats::quantile(s$expression, .25), md = stats::median(s$expression), q3 = stats::quantile(s$expression, .75))))
vi$yj <- vi$y0 - 0.08 - vi$jitter * 0.18
b2c <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = dens, aes(x, ymin = y0, ymax = y0 + h, fill = treatment, group = interaction(y0, treatment)), alpha = 0.7, colour = NA) +
  geom_segment(data = qs, aes(x = q1, xend = q3, y = y0, yend = y0), linewidth = pv_house_lw("emph")) +
  geom_point(data = qs, aes(md, y0), shape = 21, size = 1.4, stroke = 0.3, fill = "white") +
  geom_point(data = vi, aes(expression, yj, fill = treatment), shape = 21, size = 0.8, stroke = 0.15, colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tc, guide = "none") +
  annotate("text", x = c(5.75, 8.55), y = c(3.75, 2.85), label = c("WW", "SD"), colour = tc[c("WW", "SD")], fontface = "bold", hjust = 0, size = T7) +
  annotate("text", x = 9.85, y = 4.45, label = "VvNCED3", fontface = "italic", hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = T7) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(3.15, 1.05), labels = c("Leaf", "Root"), limits = c(0.2, 4.55), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(2, 10), breaks = c(3, 6, 9), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Expression (log2 CPM)", y = NULL) + th +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black"))

# d density of DEG log2 FC ----------------------------------------------------------------------
dl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Leaf", "Root"), function(t) {
  d <- stats::density(fc$log2fc[fc$tissue == t], from = -5, to = 5, n = 256, adjust = 0.9); data.frame(tissue = t, x = d$x, y = d$y) }))
tcol <- tis_c[c("Leaf", "Root")]
b2d <- ggplot(dl, aes(x, y, colour = tissue)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "22", linewidth = pv_house_lw("ref"), colour = grey[["ref"]]) +
  geom_line(linewidth = pv_house_lw("main")) +
  annotate("text", x = c(-0.5, 2.9), y = c(0.3, 0.275), label = c("Leaf", "Root"), colour = tcol, hjust = c(1, 0), fontface = "bold", size = T7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = tcol, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-5, 5), breaks = c(-4, 0, 4), labels = minus, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.35), breaks = c(0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "log2 FC of DEGs", y = "Density") + th

mosaic <- pv_house_mosaic(list(
  list(plot = footnote(tile(b2a, "a")), at = c(1, 1), cells = c(2, 1)),
  list(plot = tile(b2b, "b", t = 11.4), at = c(1, 2), cells = c(2, 2)),
  list(plot = tile(b2c, "c"), at = c(1, 4), cells = c(1, 1)),
  list(plot = tile(b2d, "d"), at = c(2, 4), cells = c(1, 1))
), cells = page_cells)
mosaic <- top_anchor(mosaic, pv_grid_span(page_cells[2]) + if (page_cells[2] == 4) 2 else 0)
pv_save_house(mosaic, "figure", cells = page_cells)

grDevices::dev.off()
message("wrote preview.png")

# House mosaic, GWAS: double-column 4x2 page (183 x 89 mm) of a simulated drought tolerance GWAS in
# grapevine: genome-wide Manhattan (4x1 long panel), regional plot of the top locus, effect of the
# lead SNP (box + raw points) and allele frequency by population (stacked bars). Reads data*.csv only.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(ggplot2); library(patchwork) })
source("../../../styles/r/theme_house.R")
grDevices::cairo_pdf(tempfile(fileext = ".pdf"))   # Arial metrics while tiles are measured; closed at the end
pal <- pv_palette("house"); grey <- pv_palette("house_grey"); warm <- pv_palette("house_warm")
TAG_PT <- 10; T7 <- pv_pt2size(7)
minus <- function(x) gsub("-", "\u2212", if (is.character(x)) x else format(x, trim = TRUE))   # no padding of strings
pt_layer <- function(...) geom_point(shape = HOUSE_POINT$shape, size = HOUSE_POINT$size,
                                     stroke = HOUSE_POINT$stroke, colour = "black", ...)
th <- theme_house()
tc <- c(WW = grey[["mid"]], SD = pal[["red"]])                         # treatment colours (whole series)
tis <- c("Leaf", "Root", "Shoot tip", "Berry skin", "Seed")
tis_c <- stats::setNames(unname(pal[c("green", "brown", "gold", "purple", "sky")]), tis)   # one colour per tissue
rd <- function(f) utils::read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

# --- tile helpers: every panel is a standalone ggplot placed on whole grid cells by
# pv_house_mosaic(). tile() pins the outer bands so panel frames line up across tiles.
# Fixed outer bands (mm) so panel frames line up across tiles in the same column/row:
# left = y ticks + title, bottom = x ticks + title, top = room for the tag.
BAND <- list(l = 11.5, b = 8.6, t = 4.2, r = 1.2)
.mm <- function(u) as.numeric(grid::convertUnit(u, "mm", valueOnly = TRUE))
.width_mm  <- function(g, idx) if (length(idx)) sum(vapply(idx, function(i) .mm(grid::convertWidth(g$widths[i], "mm")), 0)) else 0
.height_mm <- function(g, idx) if (length(idx)) sum(vapply(idx, function(i) .mm(grid::convertHeight(g$heights[i], "mm")), 0)) else 0

# tile(): ggplot -> grob with fixed bands and a bold tag at the tile's top-left corner.
tile <- function(p, tag = NULL, l = BAND$l, b = BAND$b, t = BAND$t, r = BAND$r) {
  p <- .pv_set_text_family(p + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)))
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)
  pan <- g$layout[grepl("^panel", g$layout$name), ]
  pl <- min(pan$l); pr <- max(pan$r); pt <- min(pan$t); pb <- max(pan$b)
  nc <- length(g$widths); nr <- length(g$heights)
  fit <- function(have, want, side) {
    if (have > want + 0.01) stop(sprintf("tile %s: %s band needs %.2f mm > %.2f", tag, side, have, want))
    grid::unit(want - have, "mm")
  }
  g$widths[1]   <- g$widths[1]  + fit(.width_mm(g, seq_len(pl - 1)), l, "left")
  g$widths[nc]  <- g$widths[nc] + fit(.width_mm(g, if (pr < nc) (pr + 1):nc else integer()), r, "right")
  g$heights[1]  <- g$heights[1] + fit(.height_mm(g, seq_len(pt - 1)), t, "top")
  g$heights[nr] <- g$heights[nr] + fit(.height_mm(g, if (pb < nr) (pb + 1):nr else integer()), b, "bottom")
  if (!is.null(tag)) g <- add_tag(g, tag)
  g
}
add_tag <- function(g, tag) {
  grid::grobTree(g, grid::textGrob(tag, x = grid::unit(0.3, "mm"), y = grid::unit(1, "npc") - grid::unit(0.2, "mm"),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = house_family(), fontface = "bold", fontsize = TAG_PT)))
}
# footnote(): small grey 7 pt note inside a tile's band (simulated data disclaimer)
SIM_NOTE <- "Simulated data for illustration; not biological results"
footnote <- function(g, label = SIM_NOTE, x = 1, y = 1, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, dx = -1.2, dy = -0.6) {
  grid::grobTree(g, grid::textGrob(label, x = grid::unit(x, "npc") + grid::unit(dx, "mm"), y = grid::unit(y, "npc") + grid::unit(dy, "mm"),
    hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust, gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = house_family(), fontsize = 7, col = grey[["mid"]], lineheight = 0.95)))
}
# top_anchor(): cairo_pdf truncates the page to whole points (e.g. 183 mm = 518.74 pt -> 518 pt) and the
# mosaic is placed from the bottom, so the top lost up to 0.26 mm. On PDF devices, shift the page down by
# that fraction so blocks are laid out from the top edge; PNG devices are exact and need no shift.
top_anchor <- function(m, h_mm) structure(grid::gTree(children = grid::gList(m), h_mm = h_mm, cl = c("pv_top", class(m))),
                                          pv_cells = attr(m, "pv_cells"))
makeContext.pv_top <- function(x) {
  h_pt <- x$h_mm / 25.4 * 72
  dy <- if (grepl("pdf", names(grDevices::dev.cur()), ignore.case = TRUE)) h_pt - floor(h_pt) else 0
  x$vp <- grid::viewport(y = grid::unit(1, "npc") - grid::unit(dy, "bigpts"), height = grid::unit(1, "npc"), just = "top")
  x
}
# patchwork / composite tiles: tag only (they control their own inner layout)
tile_pw <- function(p, tag) add_tag(patchwork::patchworkGrob(p), tag)

# --- parameters ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
page_cells <- c(4, 2)
lead_genes <- data.frame(chr = c(4, 11, 17), lab = c("VvNCED3", "VvPIP2;1", "VvLEA4"))   # candidate gene per peak
zoom <- c(10.8, 13.8)    # b: chr 4 window (Mb)
alpha <- 0.05            # Bonferroni: alpha / number of SNPs tested (rows of data.csv)

snp <- rd("data.csv"); n_snp <- nrow(snp); thr <- -log10(alpha / n_snp)
 chrs <- rd("data_chr.csv"); gt <- rd("data_genotype.csv"); af <- rd("data_allele.csv")

# a Manhattan -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
off <- c(0, cumsum(chrs$length_mb + 1.2))[seq_len(nrow(chrs))]
snp$x <- snp$pos + off[snp$chr]; snp$lp <- -log10(snp$p)
mid <- off + chrs$length_mb / 2
leads <- do.call(rbind, lapply(lead_genes$chr, function(c) { s <- snp[snp$chr == c, ]; s[which.max(s$lp), ] }))
leads$lab <- lead_genes$lab
# peak labels name the SNP, not a gene: "chrN lead SNP (near Gene)", gene in italics (plotmath)
leads$txt <- sprintf('"chr%d lead SNP (near "*italic("%s")*")"', leads$chr, leads$lab)
leads$side <- ifelse(leads$x > 0.5 * max(snp$x), -1, 1)                 # right-hand peaks: label on the left
snp$col <- ifelse(snp$lp > thr, pal[["red"]], ifelse(snp$chr %% 2 == 1, pal[["blue"]], pal[["sky"]]))   # significant = red
b3a <- ggplot(snp, aes(x, lp)) + geom_point(aes(colour = I(col)), size = 0.35, shape = 16) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = thr, linetype = "22", linewidth = pv_house_lw("ref"), colour = pal[["red"]]) +
  geom_point(data = leads, shape = 23, size = 1.9, stroke = 0.3, fill = pal[["red"]], colour = "black") +
  geom_text(data = leads, aes(x = x + 6 * side, label = txt, hjust = ifelse(side > 0, 0, 1)), size = T7, parse = TRUE) +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = thr + 0.35, label = sprintf("Bonferroni (0.05/%s), \u2212log10 P = %.1f", format(n_snp, big.mark = ","), thr), hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = T7, colour = pal[["red"]]) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = mid, labels = chrs$chr, limits = c(-1, max(snp$x) + 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 13), breaks = c(0, 4, 8, 12), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Chromosome", y = "\u2212log10 P") + th

# b regional plot of the top locus, points coloured by r2 to the lead SNP ----------------------
loc <- snp[snp$chr == 4 & snp$pos > zoom[1] & snp$pos < zoom[2], ]
lead <- leads[leads$chr == 4, ]
# consistency: the genome-wide top hit is VvNCED3 on chr 4 (house-mosaic-aba-kinetics b claims it)
# and it is the lead SNP of the zoomed window
stopifnot(leads$lab[which.max(leads$lp)] == "VvNCED3", all(leads$lp > thr), all(leads$lab != c("VvABF2", "VvHAI1")[1]), lead$chr == 4, lead$lp == max(loc$lp), !anyNA(loc$r2))
r2_cols <- c(pal[["blue"]], pal[["sky"]], pal[["green"]], pal[["orange"]], pal[["red"]])   # r2 bins low -> high; labels use the same vector
loc$bin <- cut(loc$r2, c(-0.01, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1.01), labels = FALSE)
gm <- data.frame(s = c(11.1, 11.75, 12.15, 12.55, 13.05), e = c(11.5, 12.0, 12.45, 12.85, 13.5),
                 g = c("VvABF2", "", "VvNCED3", "", "VvHAI1"))
b3b <- ggplot(loc, aes(pos, lp)) +
  geom_rect(data = gm, aes(xmin = s, xmax = e, ymin = -2.0, ymax = -1.0), fill = grey[["dark"]], inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  annotate("segment", x = zoom[1], xend = zoom[2], y = -1.5, yend = -1.5, linewidth = pv_house_lw("frame")) +
  geom_text(data = gm[gm$g != "", ], aes(x = (s + e) / 2, y = -2.3, label = g), vjust = 1, size = T7, fontface = "italic", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = thr, linetype = "22", linewidth = pv_house_lw("ref"), colour = pal[["red"]]) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = I(r2_cols[bin])), shape = 21, size = 1.3, stroke = 0.2, colour = "black") +
  geom_point(data = lead, shape = 23, size = 2.2, stroke = 0.3, fill = pal[["magenta"]], colour = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = zoom[1] + 0.05, y = c(12.9, 11.3), label = c("Lead SNP (magenta);", "causal gene not resolved"),
           hjust = 0, size = T7, colour = c(pal[["magenta"]], grey[["mid"]])) +
  annotate("text", x = zoom[2] - 0.05, y = c(12.9, 11.3, 9.7, 8.1, 6.5), label = c("r\u00b2 > 0.8", "0.6\u20130.8", "0.4\u20130.6", "0.2\u20130.4", "< 0.2"),
           colour = rev(r2_cols), hjust = 1, size = T7) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = zoom, breaks = c(11, 12, 13), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-4.2, 14), breaks = c(0, 4, 8, 12), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Chr 4 position (Mb)", y = "\u2212log10 P") + th

# c lead-SNP genotype effect --------------------------------------------------------------------
gt$x <- match(gt$genotype, c("AA", "AG", "GG"))
gcol <- c(AA = grey[["mid"]], AG = warm[3], GG = pal[["red"]])
b3c <- ggplot(gt, aes(x, dti, group = genotype)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = x + 0.16 * jitter, fill = genotype), shape = 21, size = 0.9, stroke = 0.15, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = NA, width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = pv_house_lw(0.6)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gcol, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c("AA", "AG", "GG"), limits = c(0.4, 3.6), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.15, 0.95), breaks = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Lead SNP genotype", y = "Drought tolerance index") + th

# d allele frequency per population (stacked to 100%) -----------------------------------------
pops <- af$population
af <- rbind(data.frame(pop = pops, al = "G", f = af$g_percent), data.frame(pop = pops, al = "A", f = 100 - af$g_percent))
af$pop <- factor(af$pop, levels = pops); af$al <- factor(af$al, levels = c("A", "G"))
af$yi <- length(pops) + 1 - as.integer(af$pop)
b3d <- ggplot(af, aes(f, yi, fill = al)) + geom_col(width = 0.68, orientation = "y", colour = "white", linewidth = pv_house_lw(0.3)) +
  geom_text(data = af[af$al == "G", ], aes(x = f / 2, label = f), colour = "white", size = T7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(A = grey[["light"]], G = pal[["red"]]), guide = "none") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = length(pops) + 0.45, label = "DTI-increasing\nallele (G), %", hjust = 0, vjust = 0, lineheight = 0.9, colour = pal[["red"]], size = T7) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = rev(seq_along(pops)), labels = pops, limits = c(0.5, length(pops) + 1.55), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = c(0, 50, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Allele frequency (%)", y = NULL) + th

mosaic <- pv_house_mosaic(list(
  list(plot = footnote(tile(b3a, "a")), at = c(1, 1), cells = c(4, 1)),
  list(plot = tile(b3b, "b"), at = c(1, 2), cells = c(2, 1)),
  list(plot = tile(b3c, "c"), at = c(3, 2), cells = c(1, 1)),
  list(plot = tile(b3d, "d", r = 3), at = c(4, 2), cells = c(1, 1))   # r: half of "100" overhangs the frame
), cells = page_cells)
mosaic <- top_anchor(mosaic, pv_grid_span(page_cells[2]) + if (page_cells[2] == 4) 2 else 0)
pv_save_house(mosaic, "figure", cells = page_cells)

grDevices::dev.off()
message("wrote preview.png")

# House mosaic, transcriptome: overview (PCA, DEG counts), main result (heatmap, UpSet of upregulated
# DEGs) and statistics (GO forest, up/down share) of a simulated grapevine drought trial on a 4x3 page
# (183 x 135 mm). Reads data*.csv only. Run from this directory.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(ggplot2); library(patchwork) })
source("../../../styles/r/theme_house.R")
grDevices::cairo_pdf(tempfile(fileext = ".pdf"))   # Arial metrics while tiles are measured; closed at the end
pal <- pv_palette("house"); grey <- pv_palette("house_grey"); warm <- pv_palette("house_warm")
TAG_PT <- 10; T7 <- pv_pt2size(7)
minus <- function(x) gsub("-", "\u2212", if (is.character(x)) x else format(x, trim = TRUE))   # no padding of strings
pt_layer <- function(...) geom_point(shape = HOUSE_POINT$shape, size = HOUSE_POINT$size,
                                     stroke = HOUSE_POINT$stroke, colour = "black", ...)
th <- theme_house()
tc <- c(WW = grey[["mid"]], SD = pal[["red"]])                         # treatment colours (whole series)
tis <- c("Leaf", "Root", "Shoot tip", "Berry skin", "Seed")
tis_c <- stats::setNames(unname(pal[c("green", "brown", "gold", "purple", "sky")]), tis)   # one colour per tissue
rd <- function(f) utils::read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

# --- tile helpers: every panel is a standalone ggplot placed on whole grid cells by
# pv_house_mosaic(). tile() pins the outer bands so panel frames line up across tiles.
# Fixed outer bands (mm) so panel frames line up across tiles in the same column/row:
# left = y ticks + title, bottom = x ticks + title, top = room for the tag.
BAND <- list(l = 11.5, b = 8.6, t = 4.2, r = 1.2)
.mm <- function(u) as.numeric(grid::convertUnit(u, "mm", valueOnly = TRUE))
.width_mm  <- function(g, idx) if (length(idx)) sum(vapply(idx, function(i) .mm(grid::convertWidth(g$widths[i], "mm")), 0)) else 0
.height_mm <- function(g, idx) if (length(idx)) sum(vapply(idx, function(i) .mm(grid::convertHeight(g$heights[i], "mm")), 0)) else 0

# tile(): ggplot -> grob with fixed bands and a bold tag at the tile's top-left corner.
tile <- function(p, tag = NULL, l = BAND$l, b = BAND$b, t = BAND$t, r = BAND$r) {
  p <- .pv_set_text_family(p + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)))
  g <- ggplotGrob(p)
  pan <- g$layout[grepl("^panel", g$layout$name), ]
  pl <- min(pan$l); pr <- max(pan$r); pt <- min(pan$t); pb <- max(pan$b)
  nc <- length(g$widths); nr <- length(g$heights)
  fit <- function(have, want, side) {
    if (have > want + 0.01) stop(sprintf("tile %s: %s band needs %.2f mm > %.2f", tag, side, have, want))
    grid::unit(want - have, "mm")
  }
  g$widths[1]   <- g$widths[1]  + fit(.width_mm(g, seq_len(pl - 1)), l, "left")
  g$widths[nc]  <- g$widths[nc] + fit(.width_mm(g, if (pr < nc) (pr + 1):nc else integer()), r, "right")
  g$heights[1]  <- g$heights[1] + fit(.height_mm(g, seq_len(pt - 1)), t, "top")
  g$heights[nr] <- g$heights[nr] + fit(.height_mm(g, if (pb < nr) (pb + 1):nr else integer()), b, "bottom")
  if (!is.null(tag)) g <- add_tag(g, tag)
  g
}
add_tag <- function(g, tag) {
  grid::grobTree(g, grid::textGrob(tag, x = grid::unit(0.3, "mm"), y = grid::unit(1, "npc") - grid::unit(0.2, "mm"),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = house_family(), fontface = "bold", fontsize = TAG_PT)))
}
# footnote(): small grey 7 pt note inside a tile's band (simulated data disclaimer)
SIM_NOTE <- "Simulated data for illustration; not biological results"
footnote <- function(g, label = SIM_NOTE, x = 1, y = 1, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, dx = -1.2, dy = -0.6) {
  grid::grobTree(g, grid::textGrob(label, x = grid::unit(x, "npc") + grid::unit(dx, "mm"), y = grid::unit(y, "npc") + grid::unit(dy, "mm"),
    hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust, gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = house_family(), fontsize = 7, col = grey[["mid"]], lineheight = 0.95)))
}
# top_anchor(): cairo_pdf truncates the page to whole points (e.g. 183 mm = 518.74 pt -> 518 pt) and the
# mosaic is placed from the bottom, so the top lost up to 0.26 mm. On PDF devices, shift the page down by
# that fraction so blocks are laid out from the top edge; PNG devices are exact and need no shift.
top_anchor <- function(m, h_mm) structure(grid::gTree(children = grid::gList(m), h_mm = h_mm, cl = c("pv_top", class(m))),
                                          pv_cells = attr(m, "pv_cells"))
makeContext.pv_top <- function(x) {
  h_pt <- x$h_mm / 25.4 * 72
  dy <- if (grepl("pdf", names(grDevices::dev.cur()), ignore.case = TRUE)) h_pt - floor(h_pt) else 0
  x$vp <- grid::viewport(y = grid::unit(1, "npc") - grid::unit(dy, "bigpts"), height = grid::unit(1, "npc"), just = "top")
  x
}
# patchwork / composite tiles: tag only (they control their own inner layout)
tile_pw <- function(p, tag) add_tag(patchwork::patchworkGrob(p), tag)

# Text colour on a filled shape (WCAG 2.x, as in house-upset #32): white if its contrast
# reaches 4.5:1, otherwise near-black #1A1A1A.
wcag_lum <- function(hex) { c <- grDevices::col2rgb(hex)[, 1] / 255
  c <- ifelse(c <= 0.04045, c / 12.92, ((c + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4); sum(c(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722) * c) }
wcag_contrast <- function(a, b) { l <- sort(c(wcag_lum(a), wcag_lum(b)), decreasing = TRUE); (l[1] + 0.05) / (l[2] + 0.05) }
on_fill_text <- function(fill) vapply(fill, function(f) if (wcag_contrast("#FFFFFF", f) >= 4.5) "#FFFFFF" else "#1A1A1A", "", USE.NAMES = FALSE)

# UpSet as one tile. m: logical matrix items x sets (colnames = set labels).
# Layout: [note + key | intersection bars] over [set-size bars | set names | matrix]; the note
# block fills the corner above the set bars. Set-size values: inside the bar end when they fit
# with 1 mm either side (colour by on_fill_text), else just outside in the set colour.
upset_tile <- function(m, cols, n_show, tag, set_w = c(22, 16), bar_frac = 0.5,
                       ylab = "Shared genes", unit = "genes", dot = 1.8, head = NULL) {
  sets <- colnames(m); k <- length(sets)
  key <- apply(m, 1, function(r) paste(as.integer(r), collapse = ""))
  key <- key[grepl("1", key)]
  tab_all <- sort(table(key), decreasing = TRUE); n_inter <- length(tab_all)
  tab <- tab_all[seq_len(min(n_show, n_inter))]
  bits <- do.call(rbind, lapply(strsplit(names(tab), ""), as.integer))
  inter <- data.frame(x = seq_along(tab), n = as.integer(tab), deg = rowSums(bits))
  inter$fill <- ifelse(inter$deg == 1, cols[apply(bits, 1, which.max)], "#000000")
  set_n <- data.frame(set = factor(sets, levels = sets), row = k:1, n = colSums(m), fill = cols)
  y_top <- ceiling(max(inter$n) * 1.3 / 50) * 50
  shade <- data.frame(x = seq(2, nrow(inter), 2))
  xs <- scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, nrow(inter) + 0.5), expand = c(0, 0))
  ys <- scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.5, k + 0.5), expand = c(0, 0))
  noax <- theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank())
  blank_xy <- theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
                    axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank())
  pb <- ggplot(inter) +
    geom_rect(data = shade, aes(xmin = x - 0.5, xmax = x + 0.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), fill = grey[["bg"]], inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_col(aes(x, n, fill = I(fill)), width = 0.66) +
    geom_text(aes(x, n, label = n, colour = I(fill)), vjust = -0.35, size = T7) +
    xs + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_top), breaks = c(0, floor(y_top * 0.8 / 100) * 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(y = ylab) + th + noax + theme(plot.margin = margin(4.2, 1.2, 0, 0, "mm"))
  dots <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(bits)), function(i)
    data.frame(x = i, row = k:1, on = bits[i, ] == 1, fill = ifelse(inter$deg[i] == 1, inter$fill[i], "#000000"))))
  segs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(bits)), function(i) { r <- (k:1)[bits[i, ] == 1]
    data.frame(x = i, y0 = min(r), y1 = max(r)) }))
  pm <- ggplot() +
    geom_rect(data = shade, aes(xmin = x - 0.5, xmax = x + 0.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), fill = grey[["bg"]]) +
    geom_point(data = dots[!dots$on, ], aes(x, row), shape = 21, size = dot, stroke = HOUSE_POINT$stroke, fill = grey[["light"]], colour = grey[["light"]]) +
    geom_segment(data = segs, aes(x, y0, xend = x, yend = y1), linewidth = pv_house_lw("main")) +
    geom_point(data = dots[dots$on, ], aes(x, row, fill = I(fill)), shape = 21, size = dot, stroke = HOUSE_POINT$stroke, colour = "black") +
    xs + ys + th + blank_xy + theme(plot.margin = margin(0.8, 1.2, 0, 0, "mm"))
  x_set <- ceiling(max(set_n$n) * 1.08 / 250) * 250
  dig <- 0.556 * 7 * 25.4 / 72; pad <- 1
  set_n$inside <- set_n$n / x_set * set_w[1] >= nchar(set_n$n) * dig + 2 * pad
  set_n$lab_col <- ifelse(set_n$inside, on_fill_text(set_n$fill), set_n$fill)
  set_n$lab_x <- set_n$n + ifelse(set_n$inside, -1, 1.2) * pad / set_w[1] * x_set
  set_n$lab_h <- ifelse(set_n$inside, 0, 1)
  ps <- ggplot(set_n, aes(n, row)) + geom_col(aes(fill = I(fill)), width = 0.74, orientation = "y") +
    geom_text(aes(x = lab_x, label = format(n, big.mark = ","), hjust = lab_h, colour = I(lab_col)), size = T7) +
    scale_x_reverse(limits = c(x_set, 0), breaks = c(x_set, 0), labels = function(v) format(v, big.mark = ","), expand = c(0, 0)) + ys +
    labs(x = "Set size") + th + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                                      plot.margin = margin(0.8, 1.5, 0, 0.4, "mm"))   # 1.5 mm gap to the set names
  pl <- ggplot(set_n, aes(1.95, row, label = set, colour = I(fill))) + geom_text(size = T7, hjust = 1) + ys +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2), expand = c(0, 0)) + theme_void() + theme(plot.margin = margin(0.8, 0, 0, 0, "mm"))
  # two-line note at the top-left: what is shown out of what (tissue colour = one tissue, black = shared)
  nl <- data.frame(y = c(5.1, 4.05), x = 0,
                   lab = c(sprintf("Top %d of %d intersections", nrow(inter), n_inter),
                           sprintf("%s of %s %s", format(sum(tab), big.mark = ","), format(sum(tab_all), big.mark = ","), unit)),
                   col = c("#000000", grey[["mid"]]))
  pn <- ggplot() + geom_text(data = nl, aes(x, y, label = lab, colour = I(col)), hjust = 0, size = T7) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.3, 5.6), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + theme_void() + theme(plot.margin = margin(4.2, 0, 0.5, 0.6, "mm"))
  p <- pn + pb + ps + pl + pm + plot_layout(design = "AAB\nCDE", widths = unit(c(set_w, 1), c("mm", "mm", "null")),
                                             heights = c(bar_frac, 1 - bar_frac))
  tile_pw(p, tag)
}
# --- parameters ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
page_cells <- c(4, 3)
# One SD-vs-WW contrast per tissue at a single sampling time (make_data.R simulates no time course, so no union).
# ASCII ">=" keeps the PDF to Arial subsets only.
DEG_DEF <- "DEG: |log2FC| >= 1, padj < 0.05, SD vs WW, 1 time point; e, f: upregulated genes only."
FOOT <- paste(DEG_DEF, "Simulated data for illustration; not biological results")
FOOT_X <- 0.0   # right inset (mm): ends on the block edge at 182 mm, clear of e's "Set size" title
n_show <- 12          # UpSet: intersections shown
BT <- 7; BB <- 8.6    # shared top / bottom band of a, b, c, d so their frames line up
LB <- 14.5            # left band of a, b: room for "Berry skin" / "Shoot tip"

smp <- rd("data.csv"); deg <- rd("data_deg.csv"); hm <- rd("data_heatmap.csv"); go <- rd("data_go.csv")
up <- rd("data_upset.csv")
deg$n <- ifelse(deg$direction == "Down", -deg$n, deg$n)

# a PCA ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
b1a <- ggplot(smp, aes(pc1, pc2)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = treatment, shape = tissue), size = HOUSE_POINT$size, stroke = HOUSE_POINT$stroke, colour = "black") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Leaf = 21, Root = 24), guide = "none") + scale_fill_manual(values = tc, guide = "none") +
  annotate("text", x = c(-18, 20), y = -21, label = c("Leaf", "Root"), size = T7, colour = tis_c[c("Leaf", "Root")], fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 30, y = c(20.5, 15.5), label = c("SD", "WW"), colour = tc[c("SD", "WW")], fontface = "bold", size = T7, hjust = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-32, 32), breaks = c(-20, 0, 20), labels = minus, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-25, 24), breaks = c(-20, 0, 20), labels = minus, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "PC1 (48%)", y = "PC2 (21%)") + th

# b DEG counts, diverging horizontal bars ----------------------------------------------------
deg$yi <- 6 - match(deg$tissue, tis)
b1b <- ggplot(deg, aes(n, yi, fill = direction)) + geom_col(width = 0.68, orientation = "y") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = pv_house_lw("frame")) +
  geom_text(aes(label = format(abs(n), big.mark = ","), hjust = ifelse(n > 0, -0.12, 1.12), colour = direction), size = T7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Up = pal[["red"]], Down = pal[["blue"]]), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Up = pal[["red"]], Down = pal[["blue"]]), guide = "none") +
  annotate("text", x = c(2150, -2150), y = 5.62, label = c("Up", "Down"), hjust = c(1, 0), colour = c(pal[["red"]], pal[["blue"]]), fontface = "bold", size = T7) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 5:1, labels = tis, limits = c(0.45, 6.0), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2200, 2200), breaks = c(-1000, 0, 1000), labels = c("1k", "0", "1k"), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "DEGs (SD vs WW)", y = NULL) + th

# c heatmap with a thin group strip ---------------------------------------------------------
ng <- max(hm$gene); ns <- max(hm$sample)
cl <- unique(hm[order(hm$gene), c("gene", "cluster")])$cluster
cut_y <- ng + 1 - (cumsum(rle(cl)$lengths)[-length(rle(cl)$lengths)] + 0.5)
cl_y <- data.frame(lab = sub(" in ", " in\n", rle(cl)$values), y = ng + 1 - c(8.5, 22.5, 31))   # 2 lines: stay inside the block
strip <- data.frame(x0 = c(0.5, 4.5, 8.5, 12.5), lab = c("WW", "SD", "WW", "SD"), tis = c("Leaf", "Leaf", "Root", "Root"))
strip$txt <- paste(strip$tis, strip$lab)
b1c <- ggplot(hm, aes(sample, ng + 1 - gene, fill = z)) + geom_raster() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = cut_y, colour = "white", linewidth = pv_house_lw(1)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(4.5, 8.5, 12.5), colour = "white", linewidth = pv_house_lw(c(0.6, 1.2, 0.6))) +
  geom_text(data = cl_y, aes(x = 16.8, y = y, label = lab), hjust = 0, size = T7, lineheight = 0.9, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_rect(data = strip, aes(xmin = x0 + 0.08, xmax = x0 + 3.92, ymin = ng + 0.75, ymax = ng + 1.45), fill = tc[strip$lab], inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = strip, aes(x = x0 + 2, y = ng + 1.75, label = txt, colour = I(tc[lab])), fontface = "bold", size = T7, vjust = 0, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = pal[["blue"]], mid = "white", high = pal[["red"]], limits = c(-2, 2), guide = "none") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 16.8 + (0:19) * 0.13, xmax = 16.8 + (1:20) * 0.13, ymin = 2.2, ymax = 3.4,
           fill = scales::gradient_n_pal(c(pal[["blue"]], "white", pal[["red"]]))(seq(0, 1, length.out = 20))) +
  annotate("text", x = c(16.8, 19.4), y = 1.7, label = c(minus(-2), "2"), size = T7, vjust = 1, hjust = c(0, 1)) +
  annotate("text", x = 16.8, y = 3.9, label = "z-score", size = T7, vjust = 0, hjust = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.5, ns + 0.5), ylim = c(0.5, ng + 0.5), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = sprintf("%d libraries (%d per group)", nrow(smp), max(table(paste(smp$tissue, smp$treatment)))),
       y = sprintf("%d top DEGs", ng)) + th +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())

# d GO forest -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
go$lab <- vapply(go$term, function(t) paste(strwrap(sub("biosynthetic", "biosynth.", t), 19), collapse = "\n"), "")
go$y <- rev(seq_len(nrow(go))); go$col <- ifelse(go$or > 1, pal[["red"]], pal[["blue"]])
b1d <- ggplot(go, aes(or, y)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "22", linewidth = pv_house_lw("ref"), colour = grey[["ref"]]) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi, colour = I(col)), width = 0, orientation = "y", linewidth = pv_house_lw("errorbar")) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = I(col)), shape = 22, size = 2.1, stroke = 0.3) +
  annotate("text", x = c(0.75, 1.35), y = nrow(go) + 0.85, label = c("Down", "Up"), hjust = c(1, 0), vjust = 0, colour = c(pal[["blue"]], pal[["red"]]), fontface = "bold", size = T7) +
  scale_x_log10(limits = c(0.18, 8), oob = scales::oob_keep, breaks = c(0.25, 1, 4), labels = c("0.25", "1", "4"), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = go$y, labels = go$lab, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.4, nrow(go) + 0.6), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Odds ratio (GO)", y = NULL) + th

# e UpSet of upregulated DEGs (set sizes must equal b's Up column) ---------------------------
mm <- as.matrix(up[, tis]) == 1
up_n <- stats::setNames(deg$n[deg$direction == "Up"], deg$tissue[deg$direction == "Up"])[tis]
stopifnot(identical(as.numeric(colSums(mm)), as.numeric(up_n)))
# UpSet column capacity (measured on house-mosaic-transcriptome e, 3x1 = 135 mm): everything outside the
# intersection columns (set bars, set names, gaps, y-axis band, right margin) takes 59 mm; each column needs
# >= 4.8 mm (three-digit label 4.23 mm + 0.6 mm). Limit = floor((width_mm - 59) / 4.8): 2x1 6, 3x1 15, 4x1 25.
UPSET_OVERHEAD_MM <- 59; UPSET_COL_MM <- 4.8
stopifnot(floor((pv_grid_span(3) - UPSET_OVERHEAD_MM) / UPSET_COL_MM) >= n_show)   # e is 3 cells wide
b1e <- upset_tile(mm, unname(tis_c), n_show = n_show, tag = "e", set_w = c(26, 15), bar_frac = 0.44,
                  ylab = "Up DEGs", unit = "upregulated genes", dot = 1.5)

# f donut: the same unique upregulated DEGs as e, split by how many tissues share each gene.
# Sectors do not overlap (each gene counted once) and sum to e's unique total.
k_tis <- rowSums(mm)
ud <- data.frame(lab = c("3+ tissues", "2 tissues", "1 tissue"),          # small sectors on the right half
                 n = c(sum(k_tis >= 3), sum(k_tis == 2), sum(k_tis == 1)))
ud$f <- ud$n / sum(ud$n); ud$e <- cumsum(ud$f); ud$s <- ud$e - ud$f; ud$mid <- (ud$s + ud$e) / 2
ud$col <- warm[5:3]                                              # house_warm: upregulated family
n_unique <- sum(ud$n)
stopifnot(sum(ud$n) == nrow(mm), n_unique == nrow(mm),                                  # sectors == unique upregulated-gene total
          sum(ud$n) == sum(table(apply(mm, 1, paste, collapse = ""))),   # == e's "of N" (all intersections)
          sum(up_n) == sum(deg$n[deg$n > 0]),                       # e set sizes == b Up column (total)
          go$or[go$term == "water transport"] < 1, go$or[go$term == "response to desiccation"] > 1)
R0_FRAC <- 0.71   # inner radius: the centre text "1,846 unique / upregulated / genes" (7 pt bold, 2.5 mm line pitch) clears the ring by >= 1 mm
# drawn in mm (1 unit = 1 mm): panel spans e's data block (top of the bars to the bottom of the matrix)
F_T <- 6.13; F_B <- 10.43; f_h <- 43 - F_T - F_B   # e bar area: top of the tallest bar to the bottom of the set-size bars (measured)
cx <- 13.4; cy <- f_h / 2; R1 <- f_h / 2; R0 <- R1 * R0_FRAC
arc <- function(s, e, r) { a <- pi / 2 - 2 * pi * seq(s, e, length.out = max(3, ceiling(abs(e - s) * 120))); cbind(cx + r * cos(a), cy + r * sin(a)) }
ring <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(ud)), function(i) {
  p <- rbind(arc(ud$s[i], ud$e[i], R1), arc(ud$e[i], ud$s[i], R0)); data.frame(x = p[, 1], y = p[, 2], id = i, col = ud$col[i]) }))
# leader anchor: the point of each sector nearest 3 o'clock (the label column), so no leader crosses the ring
ud$anc <- pmin(pmax(0.25, ud$s + 0.02), ud$e - 0.02)
ang <- pi / 2 - 2 * pi * ud$anc
ud$ex <- cx + R1 * cos(ang); ud$ey <- cy + R1 * sin(ang)
ud$ly <- seq(f_h - 4, 4, length.out = nrow(ud))[rank(-ud$ey)]   # label column, same vertical order as the sectors
ud$lx <- 2 * cx + 1.2
lo <- which.min(ud$ey); ud$ly[lo] <- min(ud$ly[lo], ud$ey[lo] - 0.5)   # lowest leader slopes down off the ring bottom, never across a sector
b1f <- ggplot() + geom_polygon(data = ring, aes(x, y, group = id, fill = I(col)), colour = "white", linewidth = pv_house_lw(0.6)) +
  geom_segment(data = ud, aes(x = ex, y = ey, xend = lx - 0.6, yend = ly, colour = I(col)), linewidth = pv_house_lw("ref")) +
  geom_text(data = ud, aes(x = lx, y = ly, label = sprintf("%s\n%s", lab, format(n, big.mark = ",")), colour = I(col)),
            hjust = 0, size = T7, lineheight = 0.9) +
  # three lines centred on the ring centre; the split keeps the widest line short so the ring can be thick
  annotate("text", x = cx, y = cy + c(2.5, 0, -2.5), label = c(paste(format(n_unique, big.mark = ","), "unique"), "upregulated", "genes"),
           size = T7, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 43), expand = c(0, 0)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, f_h), oob = scales::oob_keep, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + theme_void()

mosaic <- pv_house_mosaic(list(
  list(plot = tile(b1a, "a", l = LB, t = BT, b = BB), at = c(1, 1), cells = c(1, 1)),
  list(plot = tile(b1b, "b", l = LB, t = BT, b = BB), at = c(1, 2), cells = c(1, 1)),
  list(plot = tile(b1c, "c", l = 6, r = 14, t = BT, b = BB), at = c(2, 1), cells = c(2, 2)),
  list(plot = tile(b1d, "d", l = 24, t = BT, b = BB), at = c(4, 1), cells = c(1, 2)),
  list(plot = b1e, at = c(1, 3), cells = c(3, 1)),
  list(plot = tile(b1f, "f", l = 0, b = F_B, t = F_T, r = 0), at = c(4, 3), cells = c(1, 1))
), cells = page_cells)
# page footnote: one 7 pt grey line on the bottom edge, right of e's set-size axis title
mosaic <- structure(grid::gTree(children = grid::gList(mosaic, grid::textGrob(FOOT, x = grid::unit(1, "npc") - grid::unit(FOOT_X, "mm"),
  y = grid::unit(0.9, "mm"), hjust = 1, vjust = 0, gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = house_family(), fontsize = 7, col = grey[["mid"]]))),
  cl = class(mosaic)), pv_cells = attr(mosaic, "pv_cells"))
mosaic <- top_anchor(mosaic, pv_grid_span(page_cells[2]) + if (page_cells[2] == 4) 2 else 0)
pv_save_house(mosaic, "figure", cells = page_cells)

grDevices::dev.off()
message("wrote preview.png")

# House-style small multiples: shared axes, one region per panel, trend ± s.e. per decade in the panel.
# Reads data.csv only. Run from this directory.
source("../../../styles/r/theme_house.R")
library(ggplot2)

n_cols <- 4
alpha_sig <- 0.05

df <- utils::read.csv("data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
regions <- unique(df$region)
df$region <- factor(df$region, levels = regions)
pal <- pv_palette("house")
grey <- pv_palette("house_grey")

stars <- function(p) if (p < 0.001) "***" else if (p < 0.01) "**" else if (p < 0.05) "*" else " (n.s.)"
tr <- do.call(rbind, lapply(regions, function(r) {
  s <- summary(stats::lm(anomaly_c ~ I(year / 10), data = df[df$region == r, ]))
  b <- stats::coef(s)[2, ]
  data.frame(region = factor(r, levels = regions), slope = b[[1]], se = b[[2]], p = b[[4]])
}))
tr$col <- ifelse(tr$p >= alpha_sig, grey[["mid"]], ifelse(tr$slope > 0, pal[["red"]], pal[["blue"]]))
# sign of the slope as printed (2 decimals): no sign when it rounds to zero
sign_of <- function(x) ifelse(round(x, 2) > 0, "+", ifelse(round(x, 2) < 0, "\u2212", ""))

# Environment correlation triangle with Mantel links to omics distances.
source("../../../styles/r/theme_viz.R")

# 可调参数 -----------------------------------------------------------------
p_cut <- 0.05
show_env_heatmap <- TRUE
show_links <- TRUE
link_p_only <- TRUE

df <- utils::read.csv("data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
env <- df[is.na(df$mantel_r), , drop = FALSE]
man <- df[!is.na(df$mantel_r), , drop = FALSE]

env_names <- unique(c(env$var_a, env$var_b))
# keep first-seen order from the file
env_names <- unique(c(env$var_a, env$var_b))
omics <- unique(man$var_a)

# mirror the triangle
swap <- env[env$var_a != env$var_b, ]
swap <- data.frame(var_a = swap$var_b, var_b = swap$var_a, r = swap$r, p = swap$p, mantel_r = NA_real_, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
env_full <- rbind(env, swap)
env_full$x <- match(env_full$var_b, env_names)
env_full$y <- match(env_full$var_a, env_names)
# lower triangle including diagonal (y >= x in a flipped axis)
tri <- env_full[env_full$y >= env_full$x, , drop = FALSE]

if (isTRUE(link_p_only)) man <- man[man$p < p_cut, , drop = FALSE]
# Significant Mantel r values are all positive, so a [-1, 1] scale piled every
# link on the orange end. Keep the stronger links and stretch those colours
# across the diverging palette so neighbouring curves can be told apart.
if (nrow(man)) man <- man[abs(man$mantel_r) >= 0.30, , drop = FALSE]
man$x <- length(env_names) + 0.35
man$xend <- length(env_names) + 2.4
man$y <- match(man$var_b, env_names)
om_y <- seq(1, length(env_names), length.out = length(omics))
names(om_y) <- omics
man$yend <- om_y[man$var_a]
man$sig <- ifelse(man$p < 0.01, "p < 0.01", "p < 0.05")

cols_div <- pv_palette("diverging", 7)
mantel_lim <- if (nrow(man)) range(man$mantel_r) else c(-1, 1)
mantel_breaks <- if (nrow(man)) signif(c(mantel_lim[1], mean(mantel_lim), mantel_lim[2]), 2) else c(-1, 0, 1)

p <- ggplot2::ggplot()
if (isTRUE(show_env_heatmap)) {
  p <- p + ggplot2::geom_tile(
    data = tri,
    ggplot2::aes(x, y, fill = r),
    colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15
  )
}
if (isTRUE(show_links) && nrow(man)) {
  p <- p + ggplot2::geom_curve(
    data = man,
    ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, colour = mantel_r, linewidth = abs(mantel_r), linetype = sig),
    curvature = 0.12, alpha = 0.9
  )
}
om_df <- data.frame(name = omics, x = length(env_names) + 2.55, y = om_y[omics], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
p <- p +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = om_df, ggplot2::aes(x, y), size = 1.6, colour = "grey30") +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = om_df, ggplot2::aes(x + 0.15, y, label = name),
    hjust = 0, size = 2.0, family = viz_sans_family()
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = cols_div, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Pearson r", na.value = "grey90",
    breaks = c(-1, 0, 1)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours = cols_div, limits = mantel_lim, name = "Mantel r",
    breaks = mantel_breaks
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_linewidth(range = c(0.25, 0.9), guide = "none") +
  ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(values = c("p < 0.01" = "solid", "p < 0.05" = "dashed"), name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(env_names), labels = env_names,
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = c(0.55, 2.8))
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(env_names), labels = env_names, expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = 0.45)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::guides(
    fill = ggplot2::guide_colourbar(
      title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
      barwidth = ggplot2::unit(32, "mm"), barheight = ggplot2::unit(3, "mm"),
      order = 1
    ),
    colour = ggplot2::guide_colourbar(
      title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
      barwidth = ggplot2::unit(32, "mm"), barheight = ggplot2::unit(3, "mm"),
      order = 2
    ),
    linetype = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 3, nrow = 2)
  ) +
  theme_viz() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7),
    plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(3, 8, 2, 2, "mm"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.box.spacing = ggplot2::unit(2, "mm"),
    panel.border = ggplot2::element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
  ) +
  ggplot2::coord_fixed(clip = "off")

# RDA biplot of sites and environmental arrows. Reads the two CSVs only.
# Run from this directory.
source("../../../styles/r/theme_viz.R")

# --- adjustable ---
scaling <- 2
arrow_frac <- 0.70
# ------------------

comm_df <- utils::read.csv("data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
env_df <- utils::read.csv("data_env.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
samples <- unique(comm_df$sample)
taxa <- unique(comm_df$taxon)
comm <- matrix(0, length(samples), length(taxa), dimnames = list(samples, taxa))
comm[cbind(match(comm_df$sample, samples), match(comm_df$taxon, taxa))] <- comm_df$abundance
env_df <- env_df[match(samples, env_df$sample), , drop = FALSE]
group <- comm_df$group[match(samples, comm_df$sample)]
env <- env_df[, vapply(env_df, is.numeric, logical(1)), drop = FALSE]

comm_h <- vegan::decostand(comm, method = "hellinger")
ord <- vegan::rda(comm_h ~ ., data = env)
eig <- vegan::eigenvals(ord)
pct <- 100 * eig[seq_len(2)] / sum(eig)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(pct)))

site_sc <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(ord, display = "sites", choices = 1:2, scaling = scaling))
bp_sc <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(ord, display = "bp", choices = 1:2, scaling = scaling))
names(site_sc) <- c("RDA1", "RDA2")
names(bp_sc) <- c("RDA1", "RDA2")
site_sc$group <- factor(stats::setNames(group, samples)[rownames(site_sc)],
                        levels = c("Forest", "Meadow", "Marsh"))
site_r <- max(sqrt(site_sc$RDA1^2 + site_sc$RDA2^2))
bp_r <- max(sqrt(bp_sc$RDA1^2 + bp_sc$RDA2^2))
arrow_mul <- arrow_frac * site_r / bp_r
pretty <- c(pH = "pH", Moisture = "Moisture", Nitrogen = "Nitrogen", Temp = "Temp", OrganicC = "Organic C")
arrows <- data.frame(
  lab = unname(pretty[rownames(bp_sc)]),
  x = bp_sc$RDA1 * arrow_mul,
  y = bp_sc$RDA2 * arrow_mul,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
# Label anchor sits just past the tip; hjust/vjust push the glyphs further outward.
lab_size <- 2.3
stretch <- 1.10
arrows$lx <- arrows$x * stretch
arrows$ly <- arrows$y * stretch
arrows$hjust <- ifelse(arrows$x >= 0, 0, 1)
arrows$vjust <- ifelse(arrows$y >= 0, 0, 1)
# Temp's label sits on the arrowhead. Shift it down-left, off the tip.
# Nitrogen is left where it is.
temp_pull <- arrows$lab == "Temp"
arrows$lx[temp_pull] <- arrows$lx[temp_pull] - 0.11
arrows$ly[temp_pull] <- arrows$ly[temp_pull] - 0.08
panel_mm <- 54
lim <- max(abs(c(site_sc$RDA1, site_sc$RDA2, arrows$lx, arrows$ly))) * 1.25
for (step in seq_len(5)) {
  mm_per <- panel_mm / (2 * lim)
  tw <- 0.52 * nchar(arrows$lab) * lab_size / mm_per
  th <- lab_size / mm_per
  xmin <- ifelse(arrows$hjust == 0, arrows$lx, arrows$lx - tw)
  xmax <- ifelse(arrows$hjust == 0, arrows$lx + tw, arrows$lx)
  ymin <- ifelse(arrows$vjust == 0, arrows$ly, arrows$ly - th)
  ymax <- ifelse(arrows$vjust == 0, arrows$ly + th, arrows$ly)
  lim <- max(abs(c(
    site_sc$RDA1, site_sc$RDA2, arrows$x, arrows$y, xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax
  ))) * 1.08
}
pad <- 1 / (panel_mm / (2 * lim))
collide <- FALSE
n_lab <- nrow(arrows)
if (n_lab > 1) {
  for (i in seq_len(n_lab - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):n_lab) {
      hit <- xmax[i] + pad > xmin[j] - pad && xmax[j] + pad > xmin[i] - pad &&
        ymax[i] + pad > ymin[j] - pad && ymax[j] + pad > ymin[i] - pad
      if (hit) collide <- TRUE
    }
  }
}
if (collide) lim <- lim * 1.06
if (collide) {
  label_layer <- ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = arrows,
    ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab, hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust),
    nudge_x = arrows$lx - arrows$x,
    nudge_y = arrows$ly - arrows$y,
    size = lab_size,
    colour = "black",
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.size = 0.25,
    segment.colour = "black",
    force = 0.4,
    force_pull = 0.2,
    box.padding = 0.2,
    point.padding = 0.05,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    max.iter = 5000,
    seed = 4,
    xlim = c(-lim, lim),
    ylim = c(-lim, lim),
    show.legend = FALSE
  )
} else {
  label_layer <- ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = arrows,
    ggplot2::aes(x = lx, y = ly, label = lab, hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust),
    size = lab_size,
    colour = "black"
  )
}
pal <- stats::setNames(pv_palette("categorical", nlevels(site_sc$group)), levels(site_sc$group))

p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25, colour = "#E0E0E0") +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25, colour = "#E0E0E0") +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = arrows,
    ggplot2::aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = x, yend = y),
    arrow = grid::arrow(angle = 22, length = grid::unit(1.5, "mm"), type = "closed"),
    linewidth = 0.35,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = site_sc,
    ggplot2::aes(RDA1, RDA2, colour = group),
    size = 1.7, alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  label_layer +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::coord_equal(xlim = c(-lim, lim), ylim = c(-lim, lim), expand = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = sprintf("RDA1 (%.1f%%)", pct[[1]]),
    y = sprintf("RDA2 (%.1f%%)", pct[[2]])
  ) +
  theme_viz(base_size = 7) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.02, 0.98),
    legend.justification.inside = c(0, 1),
    legend.key.height = ggplot2::unit(2.8, "mm"),
    legend.key.width = ggplot2::unit(3.6, "mm")
  )

rank_taxa <- names(sort(mean_ab, decreasing = TRUE))

# Chord diagram of flows among groups. circlize, base graphics.
source("../../../styles/r/theme_viz.R")

# 可调参数 -----------------------------------------------------------------
show_labels <- TRUE
link_alpha <- 0.55
directional <- TRUE

df <- utils::read.csv("data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
fam <- viz_sans_family()
groups0 <- sort(unique(c(df$source, df$target)))
w_src <- tapply(df$value, df$source, sum)
w_tgt <- tapply(df$value, df$target, sum)
score <- vapply(groups0, function(g) sum(w_src[g], w_tgt[g], na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
# Eight sectors pull in #fbee61 and tangle the ribbons. Five named groups plus Other.
if (length(groups0) > 6) {
  keep <- names(sort(score, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(5)]
  map_g <- function(g) if (g %in% keep) g else "Other"
  df$source <- vapply(df$source, map_g, character(1))
  df$target <- vapply(df$target, map_g, character(1))
  df <- stats::aggregate(value ~ source + target, df, sum)
  df <- df[df$source != df$target, , drop = FALSE]
  groups <- c(keep, "Other")
  pal <- c(pv_palette("categorical", length(keep)), "#E0E0E0")
} else {
  groups <- groups0
  pal <- pv_palette("categorical", length(groups))
  pal[pal == "#fbee61"] <- "#981b1e"
}
grid_col <- stats::setNames(pal, groups)
df$source <- factor(df$source, levels = groups)
df$target <- factor(df$target, levels = groups)

save_base <- function(draw, width_mm, height_mm) {
  w <- width_mm / 25.4
  h <- height_mm / 25.4
  grDevices::cairo_pdf("figure.pdf", width = w, height = h, family = fam, pointsize = 6.5)
  draw()
  grDevices::dev.off()
  grDevices::png("figure.png", width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = 600, type = "cairo", family = fam, pointsize = 6.5)
  draw()
  grDevices::dev.off()
  grDevices::png("preview.png", width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = 1200 / w, type = "cairo", family = fam, pointsize = 6.5)
  draw()
  grDevices::dev.off()
}

draw <- function() {
  graphics::par(mar = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.4, 0.2), family = fam)
  circlize::circos.clear()
  circlize::chordDiagram(
    df[, c("source", "target", "value")],
    grid.col = grid_col,
    transparency = 1 - link_alpha,
    directional = if (isTRUE(directional)) 1 else 0,
    direction.type = "arrows",
    link.arr.type = "big.arrow",
    annotationTrack = "grid",
    preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.08),
    big.gap = 4,
    small.gap = 1
  )
  if (isTRUE(show_labels)) {
    circlize::circos.track(
      track.index = 1, panel.fun = function(x, y) {
        circlize::circos.text(
          circlize::CELL_META$xcenter,
          circlize::CELL_META$ylim[1],
          circlize::CELL_META$sector.index,
          facing = "bending.outside", niceFacing = TRUE,
          adj = c(0.5, 0), cex = 0.85
        )
      }, bg.border = NA
    )

}

# Annotated phylogeny. Branch colour is population. Reads data.csv only.
source("../../../styles/r/theme_viz.R")

# 可调参数 -----------------------------------------------------------------
layout <- "rectangular" # rectangular | circular | fan | dendrogram
show_bootstrap <- TRUE
bootstrap_min <- 70
show_tip_bar <- FALSE
show_tip_label <- TRUE

df <- utils::read.csv("data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

edges_to_phylo <- function(df) {
  tip_names <- sort(setdiff(df$tip, df$parent))
  root <- setdiff(df$parent, df$tip)
  internals <- c(root, sort(setdiff(unique(df$parent), root)))
  ids <- setNames(seq_along(c(tip_names, internals)), c(tip_names, internals))
  edge <- cbind(unname(ids[df$parent]), unname(ids[df$tip]))
  bs_map <- setNames(df$bootstrap, df$tip)
  node_label <- bs_map[internals]
  node_label[is.na(node_label)] <- ""
  tr <- list(
    edge = edge,
    edge.length = df$length,
    tip.label = tip_names,
    node.label = as.character(node_label),
    Nnode = length(internals)
  )
  class(tr) <- "phylo"
  gmap <- setNames(df$group[match(tip_names, df$tip)], tip_names)
  gmap <- gmap[!is.na(gmap)]
  groups <- split(names(gmap), gmap)
  tr <- ggtree::groupOTU(tr, groups, group_name = "group")
  tr
}

tr <- edges_to_phylo(df)
lay <- if (layout == "dendrogram") "rectangular" else layout
brlen <- if (layout == "dendrogram") "none" else "branch.length"
pop_cols <- setNames(pv_palette("categorical", 4), c("North", "South", "East", "West"))

p <- ggtree::ggtree(tr, ggplot2::aes(colour = group), layout = lay, branch.length = brlen, linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = pop_cols, name = "Population", na.value = "grey30") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = if (layout == "dendrogram") NULL else "Divergence") +
  theme_viz() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.02, 0.98),
    legend.justification.inside = c(0, 1),
    plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
  )

if (isTRUE(show_tip_label) && layout %in% c("rectangular", "dendrogram")) {
  p <- p + ggtree::geom_tiplab(size = 2.1, colour = "black", offset = 0.02, family = viz_sans_family())
}
if (isTRUE(show_tip_label) && layout %in% c("circular", "fan")) {
  p <- p + ggtree::geom_tiplab2(size = 1.6, colour = "black", offset = 0.02, family = viz_sans_family())
}
if (isTRUE(show_bootstrap)) {
  nd <- p$data[!p$data$isTip & nzchar(p$data$label), , drop = FALSE]
  nd$bs <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(nd$label))
  nd <- nd[!is.na(nd$bs) & nd$bs >= bootstrap_min & !is.na(nd$branch.length), , drop = FALSE]
  # Very short branches have no room; their numbers collide with the parent node.
  short <- stats::quantile(nd$branch.length, 0.2, na.rm = TRUE)
  nd <- nd[nd$branch.length > short, , drop = FALSE]
  nd$xlab <- nd$x - 0.55 * nd$branch.length
  p <- p + ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = nd,
    ggplot2::aes(x = xlab, y = y, label = label),
    nudge_y = 0.55, vjust = 0, hjust = 0.5,
    size = 1.6, colour = "grey30", family = viz_sans_family(),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )
}

h <- 170
if (isTRUE(show_tip_bar) && layout %in% c("rectangular", "dendrogram")) {
  tip_len <- df[!is.na(df$group), c("tip", "length", "group")]
  yd <- p$data[p$data$isTip, c("label", "y")]
  tip_len <- merge(tip_len, yd, by.x = "tip", by.y = "label")
  p2 <- ggplot2::ggplot(tip_len, ggplot2::aes(length, y, fill = group)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.7, orientation = "y") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pop_cols, guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = range(p$data$y) + c(-0.5, 0.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Tip length", y = NULL) +
    theme_viz() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    )
  p <- cowplot::plot_grid(p, p2, nrow = 1, align = "h", axis = "tb", rel_widths = c(1.4, 0.45))
  h <- 180
}

pv_save(p, "figure", width_mm = 183, height_mm = if (layout %in% c("circular", "fan")) 160 else h)

figures.code_text:
# Tree aligned to a trait heatmap, or to one trait drawn as bars.
source("../../../styles/r/theme_viz.R")

# 可调参数 -----------------------------------------------------------------
anno_mode <- "heatmap" # heatmap | bar
bar_trait <- "T01"
n_clade <- 4

df <- utils::read.csv("data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
edges <- df[df$trait == "", , drop = FALSE]
traits <- df[df$trait != "", , drop = FALSE]

tip_names <- sort(setdiff(edges$tip, edges$parent))
root <- setdiff(edges$parent, edges$tip)
internals <- c(root, sort(setdiff(unique(edges$parent), root)))
ids <- setNames(seq_along(c(tip_names, internals)), c(tip_names, internals))
tr <- list(
  edge = cbind(unname(ids[edges$parent]), unname(ids[edges$tip])),
  edge.length = edges$length,
  tip.label = tip_names,
  Nnode = length(internals)
)
class(tr) <- "phylo"
tr <- ape::ladderize(tr)

d <- ape::cophenetic.phylo(tr)
cl <- stats::cutree(stats::hclust(stats::as.dist(d), method = "average"), k = n_clade)
groups <- split(names(cl), sprintf("C%d", cl))
tr <- ggtree::groupOTU(tr, groups, group_name = "clade")
clade_cols <- setNames(pv_palette("categorical", n_clade), paste0("C", seq_len(n_clade)))

p <- ggtree::ggtree(tr, ggplot2::aes(colour = clade), linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggtree::geom_tiplab(size = 1.8, colour = "black", offset = 0.01, family = viz_sans_family()) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = clade_cols, name = "Clade", na.value = "grey30") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Divergence") +
  theme_viz() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    plot.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
  )

xmax <- max(p$data$x, na.rm = TRUE)
yd <- p$data[p$data$isTip, c("label", "y")]
if (anno_mode == "bar") {
  sub <- merge(traits[traits$trait == bar_trait, , drop = FALSE], yd, by.x = "tip", by.y = "label")
  x0 <- xmax + 0.55
  p <- p + ggplot2::geom_rect(
    data = sub,
    ggplot2::aes(xmin = x0, xmax = x0 + value * 0.12, ymin = y - 0.35, ymax = y + 0.35),
    fill = pv_palette("categorical", 1), inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text", x = x0, y = max(yd$y) + 1.2, label = bar_trait,
      size = 2, hjust = 0, family = viz_sans_family()
    )
} else {
  sub <- merge(traits, yd, by.x = "tip", by.y = "label")
  sub$trait <- factor(sub$trait, levels = sprintf("T%02d", 1:12))
  sub$tx <- xmax + 0.7 + (as.numeric(sub$trait) - 1) * 0.11
  labs <- unique(sub[, c("trait", "tx")])
  p <- p + ggplot2::geom_tile(
    data = sub,
    ggplot2::aes(x = tx, y = y, fill = value),
    width = 0.1, height = 0.85, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = labs,
      ggplot2::aes(tx, max(yd$y) + 1.15, label = trait),
      size = 1.7, angle = 45, hjust = 0, inherit.aes = FALSE, family = viz_sans_family()
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(colours = pv_palette("diverging", 7), name = "Value") +
    ggplot2::guides(fill = ggplot2::guide_colourbar(
      title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0,
      barwidth = ggplot2::unit(42, "mm"),
      barheight = ggplot2::unit(3, "mm")
    ))
}
p <- p + ggplot2::expand_limits(x = xmax + 2.3, y = max(yd$y) + 2.2) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(14, 8, 2, 2))

pv_save(p, "figure", width_mm = 183, height_mm = 140)
message("wrote preview.png")

# ADMIXTURE stacked bars. Reads data.csv.
source("../../../styles/r/theme_viz.R")

# 可调参数 -----------------------------------------------------------------
k_values <- 2:6
sort_k <- 4
pop_gap <- 3
pop_order <- c("Wild N", "Wild S", "Landrace E", "Landrace W", "Cultivar A", "Cultivar B")

df <- utils::read.csv("data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sub <- df[df$k == sort_k, ]
means <- aggregate(q ~ pop + ancestry, sub, mean)
dom <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(means, means$pop), function(m) m[which.max(m$q), ]))
key <- merge(sub, dom[, c("pop", "ancestry")], by = c("pop", "ancestry"))
key <- key[order(match(key$pop, pop_order), -key$q), ]
pos <- data.frame(sample = key$sample, pop = key$pop, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
pos$pop <- factor(pos$pop, levels = pop_order)
pos$within <- ave(seq_len(nrow(pos)), pos$pop, FUN = seq_along)
n_max <- max(pos$within)
pos$x <- pos$within + (as.integer(pos$pop) - 1) * (n_max + pop_gap)
mids <- aggregate(x ~ pop, pos, mean)

plot_df <- merge(df[df$k %in% k_values, ], pos[, c("sample", "x")], by = "sample")
plot_df$k_lab <- factor(paste0("K = ", plot_df$k), levels = paste0("K = ", k_values))
anc_levels <- paste0("A", seq_len(max(k_values)))
plot_df$ancestry <- factor(plot_df$ancestry, levels = anc_levels)
pal <- pv_palette("categorical", 6)
names(pal) <- anc_levels

    expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = 0.8)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.06, 0.03)),

  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Ancestry proportion") +

    legend.position = "bottom",

    legend.key.size = ggplot2::unit(3.2, "mm"),

The dataset contains 120 individuals across 6 regions with 20 individuals each. The 6 regions are Iberia, W Europe, Balkans, Caucasus, Central Asia, and East Asia. Order the regions from west to east using geo colors 1 through 6. The data comprises 300 unlinked SNPs, which is equivalent to LD-pruned data. The plot.R script calculates the PCA directly. Variance explained is 16.42% for PC1 and 5.71% for PC2, written as 16.4% and 5.7% in the axis titles. Use direct labeling with group color text and no color blocks. Labels are placed within 2 mm of the nearest point of their own group without overlapping points. Do not use a legend. Axis limits equal the data range plus or minus 6%. Each label must be closer to its own group centroid in mm than to any other group. Place labels on the side facing away from the nearest other group. Place the footnote inside the figure, below the plot box. The in-plot footnote uses 7 pt text across two lines. The footnote reads: "n = 20 per region; 300 unlinked SNPs (equivalent to LD-pruned)" and "Simulated data for illustration; not biological results". Do not use coord_fixed because fixing the 3:1 variance ratio flattens the 2x2 canvas.

Positions must be at least 0.5 mm from points and at most 2 mm from the own group. This distance constraint is enforced by stopifnot assertions. The text_col() function applies group color if the contrast ratio is ≥ 3:1. If the contrast is lower, text_col() applies #1A1A1A. Set colors using pv_palette("geo"). Draw data points using HOUSE_POINT.

parameters.value: "Simulated data for illustration; not biological results"

figures.code_text:
# House-style PCA scatter of accessions, coloured by region with pv_palette("geo") (west -> east).
# PCA is computed here from the genotypes in data.csv; axis titles give % variance explained.
# Reads data.csv only. Run from this directory.
source("../../../styles/r/theme_house.R")
library(ggplot2)

region_order <- c("Iberia", "W Europe", "Balkans", "Caucasus", "Central Asia", "East Asia")   # west -> east
SIM_NOTE <- "Simulated data for illustration; not biological results"

d <- utils::read.csv("data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
g <- as.matrix(d[, grepl("^snp", names(d))])
g <- g[, apply(g, 2, stats::var) > 0]
pc <- stats::prcomp(g, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
ve <- 100 * pc$sdev^2 / sum(pc$sdev^2)                    # % variance explained
sc <- data.frame(region = factor(d$region, levels = region_order), pc1 = pc$x[, 1], pc2 = pc$x[, 2])
if (stats::cor(sc$pc1, as.integer(sc$region)) < 0) sc$pc1 <- -sc$pc1   # west on the left
cols <- stats::setNames(pv_palette("geo"), region_order)
n_per <- table(sc$region); n_snp <- ncol(g)
stopifnot(all(n_per == n_per[[1]]), n_snp == 300)
# the simulation draws every SNP independently (no linkage), i.e. what an LD-pruned panel approximates
FOOT <- sprintf("n = %d per region; %d unlinked SNPs (equivalent to LD-pruned)\n%s", n_per[[1]], n_snp, SIM_NOTE)
stopifnot(length(cols) == 6, nlevels(sc$region) == 6)

# --- text colour: never a new colour -----------------------------------------------------------------
# Rule: a group keeps its own palette colour for its label if that colour reaches 3:1 contrast on white
# (WCAG 2); otherwise the label uses the house near-black text colour #1A1A1A (the same constant the
# house-upset and transcriptome-mosaic contrast rules use). Group identity then comes from the label
# sitting right next to its cluster. No colour is mixed or generated.
TEXT_DARK <- "#1A1A1A"
rel_lum <- function(hex) {
  v <- grDevices::col2rgb(hex)[, 1] / 255
  v <- ifelse(v <= 0.03928, v / 12.92, ((v + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4)
  sum(c(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722) * v)
}
contrast_white <- function(hex) 1.05 / (rel_lum(hex) + 0.05)
text_col <- function(hex) if (contrast_white(hex) >= 3) hex else TEXT_DARK
tcols <- vapply(cols, text_col, "")
contrast_tab <- data.frame(region = region_order, fill = unname(cols), ratio_fill = vapply(cols, contrast_white, 0),
                           text = unname(tcols), ratio_text = vapply(tcols, contrast_white, 0))
stopifnot(all(contrast_tab$ratio_text >= 3), all(tcols %in% c(cols, TEXT_DARK)))   # no new colours

# --- direct labels next to each cluster -------------------------------------------------------------
# Work in mm on the real panel: each label is moved out from its cluster centroid along one of 24
# directions until its box clears every point by >= 0.5 mm; a placement is accepted only if the box is
# <= 2 mm from the nearest point of its own cluster, inside the panel, clear of earlier labels, and its
# centre is closer (in canvas mm, axes are not equal) to its own group centroid than to any other centroid,
# on the side of its cluster facing away from the nearest other group.
LAB_PT <- 9                                                   # 7 pt + the 2x2 single-panel bump
r_pt <- pv_point_dims()[["outer_mm"]] / 2
lab_w <- vapply(region_order, function(t) {
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(tempfile()); on.exit(grDevices::dev.off())
  grid::convertWidth(grid::grobWidth(grid::textGrob(t, gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = house_family(), fontsize = LAB_PT))),
                       "mm", valueOnly = TRUE)
}, 0)
LAB_H <- LAB_PT * 0.3528 * 0.74                               # cap height + small descender allowance, mm

build <- function(xl, yl, lab = NULL) {
  q <- ggplot(sc, aes(pc1, pc2)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = region), shape = HOUSE_POINT$shape, size = HOUSE_POINT$size, stroke = HOUSE_POINT$stroke,
               colour = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols, guide = "none") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = tcols, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = xl, labels = minus, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = yl, labels = minus, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", ve[1]), y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", ve[2]), caption = FOOT) +
    theme_house() +
    theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 5, hjust = 1, colour = pv_palette("house_grey")[["mid"]],
                                      lineheight = 0.95, margin = margin(t = 1.2, unit = "mm")),
          plot.caption.position = "plot")
  if (!is.null(lab)) q <- q + geom_text(data = lab, aes(x, y, label = region, colour = region), hjust = 0.5,
                                        vjust = 0.5, size = pv_pt2size(7))
  q
}
minus <- function(x) format(x, trim = TRUE)                  # ASCII "-" (matches the house axes; no extra font subset)
panel_mm <- function(q) {                                     # panel size on the 89 x 89 mm canvas
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(tempfile(), width = 89 / 25.4, height = 89 / 25.4); on.exit(grDevices::dev.off())
  g <- ggplot2::ggplotGrob(pv_bump_text(q, 2))
  pn <- g$layout[g$layout$name == "panel", ]
  wnull <- sum(grid::convertWidth(g$widths[-pn$l], "mm", valueOnly = TRUE))
  hnull <- sum(grid::convertHeight(g$heights[-pn$t], "mm", valueOnly = TRUE))
  c(w = 89 - wnull, h = 89 - hnull)
}
place <- function(xl, yl) {
  pm <- panel_mm(build(xl, yl))
  kx <- pm[["w"]] / diff(xl); ky <- pm[["h"]] / diff(yl)
  P <- cbind((sc$pc1 - xl[1]) * kx, (sc$pc2 - yl[1]) * ky)
  boxes <- list(); out <- NULL
  C <- t(vapply(region_order, function(r) colMeans(P[sc$region == r, , drop = FALSE]), c(0, 0)))   # centroids, mm
  dist_c <- as.matrix(stats::dist(C)); colnames(dist_c) <- rownames(dist_c) <- region_order
  for (rg in region_order) {
    own <- sc$region == rg; c0 <- colMeans(P[own, , drop = FALSE]); w <- lab_w[[rg]]; best <- NULL
    for (ang in seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 25)[-25]) {
      for (t in seq(0, 30, by = 0.2)) {
        cx <- c0[1] + t * cos(ang); cy <- c0[2] + t * sin(ang)
        bx <- c(cx - w / 2, cy - LAB_H / 2, cx + w / 2, cy + LAB_H / 2)
        dx <- pmax(bx[1] - P[, 1], 0, P[, 1] - bx[3]); dy <- pmax(bx[2] - P[, 2], 0, P[, 2] - bx[4])
        gap <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) - r_pt
        if (min(gap) < 0.5) next
        own_gap <- min(gap[own])
        dc <- sqrt((C[, 1] - cx)^2 + (C[, 2] - cy)^2)            # label centre to every centroid, mm
        nb <- names(which.min(dist_c[rg, colnames(dist_c) != rg]))   # nearest other group (centroid, mm)
        away <- sum((c(cx, cy) - C[rg, ]) * (C[nb, ] - C[rg, ])) <= 0   # label on the far side from it
        ok <- away && dc[[rg]] < min(dc[names(dc) != rg]) && own_gap <= 2 && bx[1] >= 0.8 && bx[3] <= pm[["w"]] - 0.8 && bx[2] >= 0.8 && bx[4] <= pm[["h"]] - 0.8 &&
          all(vapply(boxes, function(o) bx[3] < o[1] - 0.8 || bx[1] > o[3] + 0.8 || bx[4] < o[2] - 0.5 || bx[2] > o[4] + 0.5, TRUE))
        if (ok && (is.null(best) || own_gap < best$g)) best <- list(g = own_gap, bx = bx, dc = dc)
        break                                                 # first clear spot along this direction
      }
    }
    if (is.null(best)) return(NULL)
    boxes[[rg]] <- best$bx
    out <- rbind(out, data.frame(region = factor(rg, levels = region_order),
                                 x = xl[1] + mean(best$bx[c(1, 3)]) / kx, y = yl[1] + mean(best$bx[c(2, 4)]) / ky,
                                 own_gap_mm = best$g, own_centroid_mm = best$dc[[rg]],
                                 other_centroid_mm = min(best$dc[names(best$dc) != rg]),
                                 nearest_other = names(best$dc[names(best$dc) != rg])[which.min(best$dc[names(best$dc) != rg])]))
  }
  out
}
# tight axis ranges: start at the data range + 4 %, widen in 3 % steps only if some label has no spot
rx <- diff(range(sc$pc1)); ry <- diff(range(sc$pc2)); pad <- 0.04
repeat {
  xl <- range(sc$pc1) + c(-1, 1) * pad * rx; yl <- range(sc$pc2) + c(-1, 1) * pad * ry
  lab <- place(xl, yl)
  if (!is.null(lab) || pad > 0.3) break
  pad <- pad + 0.02                                           # widen a little if a label has no valid spot
}
stopifnot(!is.null(lab), nrow(lab) == 6, all(lab$own_gap_mm >= 0.5), all(lab$own_gap_mm <= 2),
          all(lab$own_centroid_mm < lab$other_centroid_mm))   # every label is nearest its own group centroid (mm)
p <- build(xl, yl, lab)
print(contrast_tab, digits = 3); print(lab, digits = 3); message(sprintf("axis pad %.2f", pad))

pv_save_house(p, "figure", cells = "2x2")
message(sprintf("PC1 %.2f%%, PC2 %.2f%%", ve[1], ve[2]))
message("wrote preview.png")
